results.reason: A fix that actually removes the risk means changing NotificationThresholdTracker's mutating API (unmark/delivered/park), and NotificationThresholdTrackerTests calls that API directly, so the change is not covered by the existing tests unchanged. A wrapper inside NotificationService only would leave the tracker boundary taking four loose values, which is where a field could get dropped.
results.what: send -> deliveryFinished -> tracker.{delivered,park,unmark} keep passing (vendor, label, threshold, token) as four separate values.
results.consequence: No behaviour defect today. A future fifth field could be threaded through some call sites and missed at others. The token check (isCurrent) already rejects a mismatched late completion.
results.reopen_if: A field is added to a pending crossing, or any change touches the tracker's unmark/delivered/park signatures
